description: Export a Google Doc to a real file on disk — pdf (default), docx, odt, rtf, txt, html, epub, or md. Google renders it server-side (File > Download in the UI), so page setup, pagination and layout match the editor. A doc path exports every tab; a tab path (/folder/doc/tab) exports only that tab, through an endpoint Google does not document and rate-limits — if it fails the call is refused and says so, it never falls back to the whole doc. Returns the local path and byte size. Note: Drive refuses to export files larger than 10 MB.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

dir.description: absolute local folder to save the export into (created if missing)

filename.description: override the filename (default: the doc’s title + extension)

path.description: The doc: a Drive id or URL, or /folder/doc. A tab path names its doc.

name: export_doc
title: Export a doc to a file
